steps.title: lock the tape to the jam
steps.body:
Set the Field to **sync** (Tempo, then the green encoder) and turn on the app's clock out: `start` in the app starts the Field's tape at the app's tempo. In sync with clock in enabled, the tape speed follows the external clock too.

Now the tape is part of the band, not a separate recorder.

steps.title: bend the tape
steps.body: Change the tape speed to drop a recorded part an octave, or to slow it into a wind-down at the end of a section. Try it on a 4-bar loop of chords first (field steps: VERIFY).
